system

user

Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**FADE IN:**

**INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY**

The camera pans across a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all stands 127-year-old MANUEL, beaming with pride. He is presented with a certificate and a trophy, and the crowd erupts in applause.

**ANNOUNCER (V.O.)**
Ladies and gentlemen, it is our great honor to present the world record for the Oldest Human to Ever Live, held by the incomparable Manuel!

**MANUEL**
(overcome with emotion)
Gracias, gracias... I am truly humbled.

**CUT TO:**

**INT. MANUEL'S BEDROOM - NIGHT**

Manuel lies in bed, surrounded by photos and mementos from his long life. He gazes up at the ceiling, a faraway look in his eyes. Suddenly, his mind wanders back to his youth, when he stumbled upon an intriguing theory online.

**MANUEL (V.O.)**
Quantum Immortality... I remember reading about it on the internet. The idea that, in a multiverse, every possibility plays out, and we're just living in one of them...

**CUT TO:**

**MANUEL'S MIND**

Manuel's eyes widen as the concept takes hold. He begins to see the world in a different light.

**MANUEL (V.O.)**
What if I'm not just one person? What if I'm a multitude of people, living out different lives, in different realities?

**CUT TO:**

**MANUEL'S MIND - FLASHBACKS**

Manuel sees himself as a young man, living a life of adventure and passion. He sees himself as a father, a husband, a friend. He sees himself as a multitude of people, each living out their own unique story.

**MANUEL (V.O.)**
I'm not just one person... I'm a universe of possibilities...

**CUT TO:**

**MANUEL'S MIND - DESCENT INTO MADNESS**

Manuel's mind spirals out of control. He sees himself as a god, with infinite power and knowledge. He sees himself as a prisoner, trapped in a never-ending cycle of birth and death.

**MANUEL (V.O.)**
I'm the sum of all possibilities... I'm the universe itself...

**CUT TO:**

**MANUEL'S BEDROOM - NIGHT**

Manuel's eyes snap back into focus. He's gasping for air, his chest heaving with exertion. He looks around his room, disoriented and confused.

**MANUEL**
(whispering to himself)
What's happening to me?

**CUT TO:**

**EXT. MANUEL'S HOUSE - NIGHT**

Manuel stumbles out of his house, into the night air. He looks up at the stars, and his eyes go wide with terror.

**MANUEL (V.O.)**
I'm not just one person... I'm the universe... and I'm going mad.

**FADE TO BLACK.**
